title: Friday-evening big-bang cutover has no rollback
body: Every sender switches at once with no flag. A bad deploy strands invoices **all weekend**, with the fewest people around to notice.
proposal: Cut over one account cohort at a time behind a feature flag, on a Tuesday morning.
label: risk

title: Save swallows the database error
body: `db.Put` failures are only logged, so callers believe the invoice was saved and move on. Nothing retries.
label: bug

title: Money is summed as float64
body: Floating-point prices drift by fractions of a cent across large invoices, and the comment already says the unit is cents.
proposal: Store amounts as `int64` cents and sum integers.
label: bug

title: Index invoices by account and date
body: The account history page lists invoices newest first; without the index it scans the table.
proposal: Add the composite index in the first migration.
label: performance

title: Say why the service is moving out
body: The goal states what, not why. A sentence on the pain it fixes helps reviewers judge the rest.
proposal: Add one line on the motivation, such as deploy coupling with the monolith.
label: clarity
